|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">エコー司令部の主任管制官。兵員への指令の伝達を管理する。イオン砲部隊に発射の指示を与えた。</span>
|translation='''Title''' — Toryn Farr.

'''Lore''' — Chief controller at Echo Command. She manages the transmission of orders to the troops. She gave firing orders to the ion cannon unit.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of a starship she pilots. If at a war room or combat command post, adds 1 to weapon destiny of Planet Defender Ion Cannon on the same planet.
|translation_note=Lore uses past tense and names the ion cannon unit, without English “personally.” Game text expands war room to 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所 and omits “your” on the ion cannon.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-torynfarr-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Toryn Farr]].</ref>
